theory.title: Be/get used to y used to para hábitos pasados
theory.explanation: Used to + infinitivo describe un hábito o estado pasado que ya no es cierto. Be used to + sustantivo/-ing significa estar acostumbrado a algo. Get used to + sustantivo/-ing describe el proceso de acostumbrarse.
theory.tip: Used to + infinitivo = hábito pasado. Be/get used to + nombre o -ing = estar/acostumbrarse.

patterns.label: Be/get used to y used to para hábitos pasados · 1
patterns.pattern: I used to watch television every evening.
examples:
I used to watch television every evening.
→ Antes veía la televisión todas las tardes.

patterns.label: Be/get used to y used to para hábitos pasados · 2
patterns.pattern: I'm used to reading news online now.
examples:
I'm used to reading news online now.
→ Ahora estoy acostumbrado/a a leer las noticias por internet.

patterns.label: Be/get used to y used to para hábitos pasados · 3
patterns.pattern: She is getting used to working from home.
examples:
She is getting used to working from home.
→ Ella se está acostumbrando a trabajar desde casa.

patterns.label: Be/get used to y used to para hábitos pasados · 4
patterns.pattern: We didn't use to have streaming services.
examples:
We didn't use to have streaming services.
→ Antes no teníamos servicios de contenido en streaming.

patterns.label: Be/get used to y used to para hábitos pasados · 5
patterns.pattern: They are used to speaking in public.
examples:
They are used to speaking in public.
→ Están acostumbrados a hablar en público.

patterns.label: Be/get used to y used to para hábitos pasados · 6
patterns.pattern: He got used to the new schedule quickly.
examples:
He got used to the new schedule quickly.
→ Se acostumbró rápidamente al nuevo horario.

patterns.label: Be/get used to y used to para hábitos pasados · 7
patterns.pattern: Are you used to using this editing software?
examples:
Are you used to using this editing software?
→ ¿Estás acostumbrado/a a utilizar este programa de edición?

patterns.label: Be/get used to y used to para hábitos pasados · 8
patterns.pattern: I wasn't used to waking up so early.
examples:
I wasn't used to waking up so early.
→ No estaba acostumbrado/a a levantarme tan temprano.

patterns.label: Be/get used to y used to para hábitos pasados · 9
patterns.pattern: People are getting used to shorter news videos.
examples:
People are getting used to shorter news videos.
→ La gente se está acostumbrando a los vídeos de noticias más cortos.

patterns.label: Be/get used to y used to para hábitos pasados · 10
patterns.pattern: My grandparents didn't use to watch online programmes.
examples:
My grandparents didn't use to watch online programmes.
→ Mis abuelos antes no veían programas por internet.

content.passage: When online streaming first became popular, many people found it unusual. My parents used to watch the same television programmes every week, but now they are used to choosing what they want to see. My father is getting used to reading the news on a tablet, although he still prefers printed newspapers. My grandmother didn't use to use the internet, but she has become more confident over time.

items.prompt: Describe a habit you used to have but no longer have.
items.modelAnswer: I enjoy different kinds of media because they help me learn about the world and relax. I usually choose programmes that are informative and well presented. I also like discussing films and documentaries with friends because we often have different opinions. Although some online stories are not reliable, I try to check the source before sharing them. In the future, I think media will become more personalised, but good journalism will remain important.

content.audioTranscript: A: Did you watch the new documentary last night? B: Yes, the audience really enjoyed it. A: The presenter was excellent. B: I haven't seen the next episode yet. A: I read a positive review online. B: Was it from a reliable source? A: Yes, although there was one advertisement during the break. B: I watched it on a streaming service. A: What's your opinion of the series? B: It's a very interesting programme.
